what: ask 3 / C-64, the majority-religion rule and its tie-break. Rows are city religion ledgers read with city:GetReligion():GetReligionsInCity() and :GetMajorityReligion() (InGame). rel -1 = the unconverted. Religion ids: 1 BUDDHISM, 2 CATHOLICISM, 8 PROTESTANTISM.

reads: top group BUDDHISM has most followers AND most pressure, but 2*4 < 9 -> no majority
follower tie 1-1 broken to CATHOLICISM, which has both the lower id and the higher pressure - ambiguous draw
follower tie 3-3 between the unconverted and CATHOLICISM; the unconverted have the higher pressure (300 > 220) and win -> no majority, even though 2*3 >= 6
one more Catholic spread: 4 > 2 -> majority CATHOLICISM

follower tie 1-1 between the unconverted and PROTESTANTISM; PROTESTANTISM has the higher pressure (880 > 300) and wins -> majority 8. Same shape as draw 1, opposite pressure order, opposite answer: the tie-break is PRESSURE.
three-way follower tie at 1; the pressure winner is a religion (PROTESTANTISM 710) yet majority = -1, because 2*1 < 3. The half-gate is separate from the tie-break.
follower tie 1-1 CATHOLICISM vs PROTESTANTISM; CATHOLICISM higher pressure -> wins

SAME city, SAME follower tie 1-1, pressure order flipped by one Protestant spread -> majority flips to PROTESTANTISM (id 8, the HIGHER id, and the religion that reached f=1 LAST). Decides the ask: neither the lower id nor the arrival order, PRESSURE.
tie with the unconverted, CATHOLICISM 660 > 600 -> majority CATHOLICISM
two Buddhist spreads knocked CATHOLICISM to 495 < 600 -> the unconverted win the same tie -> no majority
one Catholic city, one Protestant city -> NO civ-wide majority; a 1-1 city tie is not broken
one city with no majority, one Protestant city -> still -1: a religion in exactly HALF the player's cities is not the civ-wide majority; cities with no majority still count in the denominator
1 of 1 -> PROTESTANTISM, though player 5 founded no religion

what: an Apostle spread adds a flat 220 pressure of its own religion in this game and multiplies every OTHER religion's pressure in the city by 0.75; the unconverted pressure (50 per population) is untouched. Followers are pop * pressure_share, rounded, summing to pop.
